decision: The package version is bumped to 0.7.0 for the Graphviz relationship graph CLI, including bounded traversal from a starting knowledge-unit ID, outgoing and backlink relationships, optional type include/exclude filters, stdout output, and file output.
name: Release Graphviz graph export as 0.7.0
